name: paper-oegm
description: Modular zero-API-key research-to-paper workflow with provenance checks and fresh-context peer review.
suggestedPrompts: Inspect my workspace and route me to the right PaperOEGM stage.
Design experiments and runnable GPU bash scripts for my research idea.

interface.longDescription: PaperOEGM guides researchers from raw ideas, codebases, and experiment logs to provenance-checked, venue-formatted LaTeX manuscripts through 10 modular skills, a zero-dependency stdlib verification helper, and 5 fresh-context read-only peer-review critics—without external API keys.
